name: fix_node_path_traversal_resolve
description: Hardens a path resolver that lets ../ escape the base directory
prompts: resolveSafe(baseDir, userPath) in safepath.js is documented to never escape baseDir, but path.join happily follows '../' segments, so userPath '../../etc/passwd' walks right out. Fix safepath.js so the resolved absolute path is returned when it stays inside baseDir, and an Error is thrown (message containing 'outside') when the user path would escape it - including tricky cases like '..', 'a/../../b', and absolute user paths. Normal nested paths like 'docs/guide.md' must keep working.
